meta.title: Terms & Service Policies
meta.description: Terms of use and policies for ordering, bespoke tailoring, payment, delivery, returns and data privacy at AODAI Heritage.

title: Terms & Service Policies
subtitle: Please read these terms carefully before creating an account, placing an order or booking a bespoke ao dai at AODAI Heritage.
contactText: Our customer care team is always happy to help.

sections.title: 1. General terms
paragraphs: By visiting the website, creating an account or placing an order at AODAI Heritage, you confirm that you have read, understood and agreed to all of the terms on this page.

We may update these terms from time to time to reflect legal requirements and our business operations. A new version takes effect once published; continuing to use our services means you accept those changes.

sections.title: 2. Member accounts
paragraphs: You can sign up with an email address, a phone number or a Google account. Your registration details must be accurate, complete and kept up to date.
items: You are responsible for keeping your password and OTP codes secret; never share them with anyone, including people claiming to be our staff.
All activity on your account is deemed to be carried out by the account owner.
Let us know immediately if you notice any unauthorised access to your account.
We may suspend accounts showing signs of fraud, promotion abuse or breach of these terms.

sections.title: 3. Orders & Pricing
paragraphs: Prices are listed in Vietnamese Dong (VND), include VAT and exclude shipping fees (if any).

An order is only confirmed once you receive a confirmation from our system. If a product is out of stock or a pricing error occurs, we will contact you to adjust or cancel the order with a full refund.

sections.title: 4. Bespoke tailoring
paragraphs: Bespoke ao dai are cut and sewn individually from the measurements you provide or that our tailors take in person.
items: You are responsible for the accuracy of self-submitted measurements. Follow our measuring guide or contact a consultant if you are unsure.
Standard completion time is 7 to 14 working days after measurements, design and fabric are finalised; peak seasons (Tet, wedding season) may take longer.
Bespoke orders require a deposit of at least 50% before the fabric is cut. The deposit is non-refundable once cutting has begun.
Each bespoke order includes up to 2 free alterations within 15 days of delivery if the fit is not right.

sections.title: 5. Payment
paragraphs: We accept cash on delivery (COD), bank transfer and the online payment gateways shown at checkout.
We never store your card details; all online transactions are processed by certified, secure payment partners.

sections.title: 6. Delivery
paragraphs: Ready-to-wear items are usually delivered within 2 to 5 working days depending on your area. Exact fees and timing are shown before you confirm your order.
Please check the package on delivery. If it appears dented, torn or contains the wrong item, you may refuse it and notify us right away.

sections.title: 7. Returns & Refunds
items: Ready-to-wear items can be exchanged for another size or design within 7 days of delivery, with tags attached and unworn, unwashed and unironed.
Items with manufacturing defects are replaced or refunded in full, and we cover shipping both ways.
Bespoke items made to your measurements and clearance items are not eligible for return, except for faults on our side.
Refunds are sent to the original payment method within 5 to 10 working days after the return is approved.

sections.title: 8. Personal data privacy
paragraphs: We only collect the information we need (name, contact details, delivery address, body measurements) to process orders, tailor garments and support you.
Your data is never sold or shared with third parties, except shipping and payment partners directly serving your order, or when required by the authorities under law.
You can view, update or request deletion of your personal data in your Account page or by contacting us.

sections.title: 9. Intellectual property
paragraphs: All images, designs, patterns, articles and brand assets on this website belong to AODAI Heritage. Copying or commercial use without our written consent is strictly prohibited.

sections.title: 10. Limitation of liability & Disputes
paragraphs: Actual product colours may differ slightly from photos due to lighting and display settings; this is not considered a product defect.
Any dispute will first be resolved through negotiation. If no agreement is reached, it will be settled under the laws of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam.
